word/document.xml#p0017.text: A journey from the Andean capital to the Caribbean coast, blending Colombia’s rich history with its vibrant landscapes and timeless colonial charm. Explore the cultural treasures of Bogotá and the legends of El Dorado, then continue to Cartagena, where historic streets, golden light and turquoise waters invite you to slow down and savour the Colombian Caribbean.

word/document.xml#p0066.text: Day 1 · Upon arrival at El Dorado International Airport, you will be welcomed by your private English-speaking guide, who will accompany you throughout your stay in Bogotá. The afternoon begins with a journey into the heart of the capital, exploring the historic district of La Candelaria, with its colonial architecture and atmospheric streets. Visit the Gold Museum, the Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Collection, before continuing to Plaza de Bolívar, surrounded by some of the city’s most important historic buildings.

word/document.xml#p0067.text: The day concludes with an ascent to Monserrate, offering a different perspective of Bogotá, before returning to the hotel.

word/document.xml#p0068.text: Day 2 · Breakfast at the hotel. Today, embark on a full-day excursion to discover two of the most remarkable destinations near Bogotá: Lake Guatavita and the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá. Begin at Lake Guatavita, surrounded by the peaceful landscapes of the Andean highlands and closely associated with the legendary story of El Dorado. Enjoy a scenic walk through the reserve before visiting the picturesque town of Guatavita. Free time for lunch at a local restaurant (lunch not included).

word/document.xml#p0069.text: In the afternoon, continue to Zipaquirá and explore the extraordinary Salt Cathedral, carved approximately 180 metres underground within a former salt mine. Discover its chapels, galleries and monumental chambers before returning to Bogotá

word/document.xml#p0077.text: Day 3 · Breakfast at the hotel. After breakfast at the hotel, private transfer to El Dorado International Airport with your driver for your flight to Cartagena de Indias, one of the best-preserved colonial cities in the Americas and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Upon arrival at Rafael Núñez International Airport, you will be welcomed by your private English-speaking guide, who will accompany you throughout your stay in Cartagena.

word/document.xml#p0078.text: In the afternoon, discover Cartagena, where colonial architecture, history and Caribbean charm come together. Explore Bocagrande, Castillogrande and Manga before visiting La Popa Monastery and San Felipe de Barajas Castle. Continue on foot through the historic centre, discovering its colourful streets, picturesque squares and emblematic landmarks, including the Clock Tower, Plaza de los Coches, Plaza de Santo Domingo, Santa Catalina Cathedral, the Palace of the Inquisition and the city walls.

word/document.xml#p0079.text: The tour concludes at Las Bóvedas, a former military complex now home to an artisan market, before returning to the hotel.

word/document.xml#p0088.text: Day 4 · Breakfast at the hotel. Today, escape Cartagena for a full-day experience in the Rosario Islands, travelling by private transfer to the marina and then by shared speedboat to Isla Majagua, one of the islands of this beautiful Caribbean archipelago. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters, coral beaches and lush tropical scenery, Isla Majagua offers the perfect setting to enjoy a day by the sea, away from the bustle of Cartagena. Take time to swim, relax and savour the tranquil atmosphere of the island, surrounded by the vibrant colours of the Colombian Caribbean.

word/document.xml#p0089.text: The experience includes private hotel–marina transfers, shared speedboat transportation, a traditional Caribbean lunch, dessert, coffee or tea, and the marina tax. In the afternoon, return by shared speedboat to Cartagena, followed by your private transfer back to the hotel. A private boat experience can also be arranged as an optional upgrade, offering greater flexibility and exclusivity throughout the day.

word/document.xml#p0090.text: Day 5 · Breakfast at the hotel. Depending on the international flight schedule, enjoy some final free time in Cartagena. Private transfer to Rafael Núñez International Airport for the departure flight.
